The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
While basic file structure and lookup blocks passed, test_derived_values_and_stats failed with multiple #NAME? errors in cells H46:L47. This indicates that the generated Excel formulas use functions or named ranges not recognized by the evaluator. Specifically, the verifier reported: 'H46: expected -14.74024921155005, got #NAME?'. Avoid using non-standard Excel functions or ensure all named ranges used in formulas are explicitly defined in the workbook.
